sources.snippet: The 27B doesn't need more data — it needs the same data with more capacity to absorb it. At 27B parameters, the model has enough representational depth to extract signal that the 8B has to approximate.

sources.title: Google's AI Cracks a New Cancer Code - Decrypt
sources.snippet: In brief The Gemma-based model generated and validated a new cancer-therapy hypothesis in human cell experiments. It identified silmitasertib as a conditional amplifier that boosts immune visibility of tumors. The result hints that scaled biological AI models can invent—not just optimize—new scientific ideas.
